questions.question_text: What does the SaaS service model represent in cloud computing architecture?
Which of the following is categorized as an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) offering?
What architectural role does the central component highlighted in this diagram perform?
questions.option_a: Distributing incoming traffic evenly across backend application servers

questions.question_text: Which fundamental cloud property allows computing resources to scale up and down automatically according to real-time workload demands?
In serverless architectures (Function-as-a-Service), who is primarily responsible for patching the underlying operating system and hardware?
What type of modern enterprise facility is depicted in this photograph?
questions.option_a: A high-density data center server rack row

questions.question_text: Which cloud deployment model provides infrastructure exclusively shared by multiple organizations with common compliance or mission requirements?
In multi-tier cloud architectures, what is the primary benefit of decoupling the frontend presentation tier from the backend database?
questions.option_a: Independent scalability, improved fault tolerance, and isolated maintenance

questions.question_text: What does the 'RTO' acronym stand for in cloud disaster recovery planning?
Which storage type is best optimized for unstructured data such as audio, video, images, and backups in cloud systems?
What cloud security framework specifies the division of responsibilities between the cloud provider and the customer?
What is the primary advantage of deploying cloud workloads across multiple Availability Zones (AZs)?
questions.option_a: High availability and resilience against localized datacenter failures
questions.option_b: Zero billing costs during non-peak hours

questions.question_text: Who is widely recognized as the inventor of the World Wide Web, creating HTTP, HTML, and URLs at CERN in 1989?
What standard port number is reserved for secure encrypted web traffic (HTTPS)?
Which layer of the OSI 7-layer reference model is responsible for end-to-end communication, flow control, and error recovery (e.g. TCP/UDP)?
What physical transmission medium illustrated below carries internet backbone traffic across oceans using light pulses?
What global network visualization concept does this planetary connectivity map demonstrate?
questions.option_a: Global routing topology and interconnected Autonomous Systems (AS)

questions.question_text: What does DNS stand for in internet infrastructure?
Which HTTP response status code signifies that a requested resource was successfully found and delivered?
What protocol is used by web clients and servers to establish bidirectional, full-duplex persistent connections over a single socket?
In the TCP 3-way handshake, what sequence of flag packets is exchanged to establish a reliable connection?
What is the primary difference between IPv4 and IPv6 address formats?
questions.option_a: IPv4 uses 32-bit addresses while IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses
questions.option_b: IPv4 is encrypted by default while IPv6 is unencrypted
questions.option_c: IPv4 supports billions of times more addresses than IPv6
questions.option_d: IPv4 operates on Layer 7 while IPv6 operates on Layer 2

questions.question_text: What security mechanism prevents a script on one origin from accessing sensitive data on a different origin in modern web browsers?
Which organization coordinates global IP address space allocation and root DNS zone management?
questions.option_a: ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers)
questions.option_b: IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers)

questions.question_text: What critical component of a modern computer system is pictured in this detailed silicon die photograph?
questions.option_a: A Central Processing Unit (CPU) microprocessor die

questions.question_text: What main circuit board, pictured below, connects all computing components including CPU, RAM, storage, and expansion cards?
What hardware component translates virtual memory addresses into physical RAM addresses in modern CPUs?
Which condition is NOT one of Coffman's four necessary conditions for system deadlock to occur?
In Unix-like operating systems, what system call creates a new process by duplicating the calling process?
Which CPU scheduling algorithm gives each process a small fixed time slice (quantum) in cyclic order?
What type of hypervisor runs directly on bare-metal hardware without an underlying host operating system?
What phenomenon occurs when excessive paging activity causes the operating system to spend more time swapping memory pages than executing instructions?
What synchronization primitive allows threads to lock access to shared memory so only one thread can execute a critical section at a time?
Which memory tier sits closest to the CPU execution cores and provides the fastest access latency?
What is the primary role of an Operating System Kernel?
questions.option_a: Managing hardware resources, memory, processes, and device communication
questions.option_b: Designing user interfaces and web pages

questions.question_text: What architectural design separates the kernel into minimal core functions while moving device drivers and filesystems into user space?
Which is the best TV show?
Which iconic world landmark, constructed for the 1889 World's Fair, is shown in this picture?
questions.option_a: The Eiffel Tower in Paris, France

questions.question_text: Which ancient wonder of the world is pictured below, located on the Giza plateau in Egypt?
What standard optical disc format, introduced in 1982 by Philips and Sony, is pictured below?
Which planet in our solar system is known as the 'Red Planet' due to iron oxide on its surface?
Who wrote the famous fantasy novel series 'The Lord of the Rings'?
What is the capital city of Australia?
In the Marvel Cinematic Universe, what indestructible fictional metal is Captain America's shield made from?
Which chemical element has the symbol 'Au' on the periodic table?
What legendary band released the best-selling album 'Abbey Road' in 1969?
How many total squares are on a standard tournament chessboard?
What is the deepest known location in the Earth's oceans?
